Container.Name: site-oxidation
Container.Overview: Self-hosted website uptime monitoring. Site Oxidation checks your sites on a schedule, records outages and response times, shows daily uptime history and warns before TLS certificates expire. Alerts go out by email, Slack or Microsoft Teams. Supports multiple users and teams, CSV export, and a connectivity canary so a lost internet connection is not recorded as every site going down.[br][br]Open the web UI after install and follow the setup wizard to create the first admin account.[br][br]Leave COOKIE_SECURE as false when browsing to the server directly over http on your LAN. Set it to true once you access the app through an HTTPS reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Cloudflare Tunnel), otherwise login will not work.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web UI is served on.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database and session key. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: false for direct http access on your LAN. true when accessed through an HTTPS reverse proxy (login fails over plain http when true).

Config.Name: PROBE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS
Config.Description: true to monitor services on your LAN (e.g. 192.168.x.x addresses).

Config.Name: SMTP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS
Config.Description: true to send email alerts through an SMTP server on your LAN.

Config.Name: CERT_WARN_DAYS
Config.Description: Days before a TLS certificate expires at which it is shown as expiring soon.

Config.Name: CERT_CRITICAL_DAYS
Config.Description: Days before a TLS certificate expires at which it is shown as critical. Must not be greater than CERT_WARN_DAYS.

Config.Name: RUST_LOG
Config.Description: How much the app logs. Set to debug when reporting a problem.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).
